content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the TMC Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 06-11-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of TMC to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for TMC recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application for the Fellowship and Senior Resident positions at Tata Memorial Centre is 6 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies available for the posts of One Year Fellowship in Patient Blood Management in Oncology and Senior Resident.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The application fee for all candidates is Rs. 300/-, which can be paid online via Debit/Credit Card or UPI.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for these posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all posts is 45 years as of 6 November 2026, with applicable relaxations for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q5. What is the required qualification?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.D. in Immuno-Haematology and Blood Transfusion, Transfusion Medicine, or an equivalent degree recognized by the National Medical Commission.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any age relaxation?
faq.answer: Yes, age relaxation is provided as per government norms: 5 years for SC/ST, 3 years for OBC, and 10 years for PwD candidates.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process involves an MCQ examination (if required for shortlisting) followed by a personal interview for the qualified candidates.

faq.question: Q8. Where will the selected candidates be posted?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will be posted at Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital or Mahamana Pandit Madan Mohan Malaviya Cancer Centre in Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh.

faq.question: Q9. Is the position permanent?
faq.answer: No, these are tenured positions offered on a contract basis for a fixed period of up to one year.

faq.question: Q10. Do I need to send a hard copy of the application?
faq.answer: No, the application process is entirely online. Candidates should complete the form on the official website and keep a printout for their own records.
